  • Pläne bauen, nachhalten, kontrollieren

Wenn du Freude an strukturierter, teils monotoner Arbeit mit hohem Durchsatz hast, wirst du diese Rolle lieben. Wenn du nur brainstormen willst ist das hier nichts für dich.

  • Passende Publisher für Kundenprojekte auswählen, anfragen und Konditionen innerhalb der Vorgaben klären

  • Lektorat von SEO Texten auf Deutsch & Englisch

  • Qualität der Placements sichern: Themen‑Fit, KPIs, Verlinkung, Prüfung, Reporting

  • Bestehende Publisher-Beziehungen pflegen und neue relevante Quellen identifizieren

  • Datenpflege & Auswertungen in unseren Tools (z. B. Eigene Plattform, CRM, SEO‑Tools)

  • Prozesse mitdenken: Engpässe erkennen, Verbesserungsvorschläge machen und mit uns umsetzen

Was du mitbringst

  • 1–2+ Jahre Erfahrung in Offpage‑SEO / Linkbuilding / Digital PR oder Publisher‑Management

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort UND Schrift

Was wir dir bieten

  • Klare Verantwortlichkeit für einen Kernbereich unseres Geschäfts (Fulfillment, Offpage & Publisher)

  • Klare Ziele statt Micromanagement: du bekommst KPIs und den Rahmen, den Rest regelst du

  • Entwicklungsoptionen Richtung Lead Offpage SEO / Teamlead Publisher Management

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit fester Erreichbarkeit, Remote‑Option, 40h/Woche

description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis ist das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende. Obwohl Marken Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale investieren, können sie nicht belegen, ob daraus
Käufe wurden. Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen
Coupons, Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen bei uns keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum Einkaufsregal reichen -eine Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen und mit Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billionen ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr. Zur Verve Retail Media gehört seit kurzem der Couponing- und Cashback-Spezialist acardo.

Die Rolle in einem Satz
Du trägst eine Hunter-Mentalität in dir und gewinnst neue Umsätze bei FMCG-Marken, indem du integrierte Shopper Activation Kampagnen verkaufst: d.h. coupon-getriebene Conversion und messbarer Sales Lift, idealerweise erweitert um Screen-Präsenz im Markt.

Was du verkaufst

  • Ein kombiniertes Produkt aus digitaler Sichtbarkeit im Markt Screens an Eingang, Fläche, Kasse), Aktivierung am Point of Sale (über Coupons) und Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten (anstatt isolierter Werbeflächen oder losgelöster Coupons)
  • Kampagnen, die drei Logiken beim Kunden verbinden: Markenreichweite, Abverkauf und Kategorie-Relevanz
  • 360Grad-Aktivierung, die über den Markt hinausgeht: (Re)Targeting im CTV und weiteren Offsite-Kanälen als Verlängerung der In-Store-Kampagne
  • Konkrete Beweispunkte aus Pilotprojekten: z.B. 9% Uplift auf Store-Ebene, 20% in ausgewählten Kategorien

An wen du verkaufst

  • Direkt an FMCG-Marken
  • Die Ansprechpartner kommen meist aus Brand und Media (-Planung und -Einkauf) und verwalten drei Budgettöpfe mit unterschiedlichen Zielen, Freigabelogiken und Erfolgsmetriken

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigene Pipeline aufbauen, entwickeln, priorisieren und mit belastbarem Forecast führen
  • Neukunden und Stakeholder (horizontal und vertikal) gewinnen und Kunden zu wiederkehrenden Partnern entwickeln
  • Den kompletten Sales-Zyklus verantworten: Erstansprache, Qualifizierung, Bedarfsanalyse, Angebot, Verhandlung und Abschluss. Mit Abschluss erfolgt die Übergabe ans AdOps Team
  • Kundenziele in Media- und Aktivierungskonzepte übersetzen: Touchpoints, Reichweiten, Zielgruppen, Mechaniken Cashback, Gratis-Testen, Kategorie-Trigger), Messansatz
  • Sales-Lift-Daten und Pilotergebnisse als Beweispunkte im Pitch einsetzen, um aus ersten Testbudgets hohe wiederkehrende Volumina zu machen
  • VRM gegenüber konkurrierenden Retail-Media-Formaten klar differenzieren
  • Feedback aus dem Markt in Produkt, Pitchmaterial und Go-to-Market zurückspielen

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt

  • Du bist ein Individual Contributor ohne Personalverantwortung
  • Du berichtest direkt an die CSO
  • Du verkaufst eigenständig, aber nicht allein: Media Planning entwickelt das Kampagnen-Setup, Ad Operations steuert die Auslieferung, Data Science liefert den Wirkungsnachweis
  • Dein Fokus ist kommerziell: Pipeline, Abschluss, Kundentiefe, Wiederbuchung

Warum diese Rolle

Du liebst es, Dinge von Grund auf mit aufzubauen. Denn bei uns steigst du nicht in eine fertige Vermarktungsmaschine mit festem Produktkatalog ein, sondern du baust eine neue Mediagattung im deutschen Markt mit auf. Die Deals, die du jetzt gewinnst, werden intern und extern zu Referenzen. Sie prägen, wie Marken und Agenturen In-Store Retail Media künftig bewerten und einkaufen.

  • Echte Ownership: deine Pipeline, deine Kunden, dein Umsatz
  • Direkter Zugang zu CSO und CEO bei strategischen Kunden
  • Ein Produkt, das mehr kann als Reichweite verkaufen: Sichtbarkeit, Aktivierung und messbare Wirkung bis zum Kauf
  • AI-gestützte Tools und Workflows, die deine Produktivität vervielfachen

Wenn du lieber Benchmarks setzt als bestehende Playbooks abarbeitest, ist das die richtige Rolle.

We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You'll Do

Our Data Centre Design and Construction team is responsible for leading the expansion of CoreWeave's global footprint, managing the full lifecycle of mission-critical facility builds from pre-construction planning through commissioning and turnover. This team ensures our data centres are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational excellence to support our high-performance cloud infrastructure.

About the role

As the Data Center Construction Project Manager, you will serve as the primary owner's representative, leading the overall direction, completion, and financial outcomes of multiple data centre construction projects. In this full-time on-site role, you will administer contracts with developers and general contractors, maintaining rigorous oversight of drawings, specifications, change management, and statutory planning approvals. Your primary focus will involve supervising the installation, coordination, commissioning, and quality assurance of complex Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems, power distribution, and cooling infrastructure. Additionally, you will drive project schedules, manage multi-million pound budgets, and partner cross-functionally with supply chain, design, and executive stakeholders to ensure seamless project turnover.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of construction project management experience with direct leadership on data centre construction projects.
  • Strong technical expertise in mission-critical infrastructure, with an emphasis on MEP systems, power distribution, cooling, and redundancy protocols.
  • Demonstrated experience managing construction contracts, financial forecasting, budget development, change management, and cost estimation.
  • Proven track record of on-site project leadership, coordinating general contractors, subcontractors, statutory bodies, and vendors.
  • Strong knowledge of pre-construction services, risk management, scheduling tools, and web-based project management software.
  • Ability to work on-site full-time and possess a valid driver's licence.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience managing large-scale mission-critical infrastructure projects with contract values exceeding £80M ($100M+).
  • Recognized industry certifications, such as Project Management Professional (PMP) or LEED certification.

Wondering if you're a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring diversified experiences to our teams—even if you do not match 100% of the listed criteria.

  • You love to: Manage the full lifecycle of complex technical projects and drive on-site construction execution.
  • You're curious about: The intricacies of data centre infrastructure, next-generation MEP systems, and scaling critical facility operations.
  • You're an expert in: Construction contract management, financial forecasting, and managing general contractors.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We are in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We are not afraid of a little chaos, and we are constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take-off, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. About the Role We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer . Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client? You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them. This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them. If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you. Responsibilities Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design. Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do. Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster. Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress. Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty. Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path. Qualifications 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus. Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code. Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python. Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard. Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet. Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT. Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written). Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. raw.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
raw.description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer.

Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client?

You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec, but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

  • Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

  • Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

  • Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

  • Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

  • Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications

  • 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

  • Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

  • Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

  • Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

  • Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

  • Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.

title: Risk Operations Analyst
description: About Ryft Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms. We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity. We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform. About the Role We’re hiring a Risk Operations Analyst to sit within our first line fraud and risk function, reporting to the Fraud & Risk Manager. This role is the operational backbone of how Ryft manages its relationships with acquiring and banking partners, taking inbound queries from our acquires and bank partners and owning them through to resolution. The core of this role is investigative. When a query comes in from a banking partner, we need someone who can trace a transaction end-to-end through our systems, understand what the bank is actually asking, produce a response that meets their expectations, and critically, question what they find along the way rather than closing the thread at the first plausible answer. Alongside partner queries, you’ll carry out merchant risk monitoring as part of the broader fraud and risk operation; reviewing merchant behaviour, flagging anomalies, and feeding intelligence into the fraud detection and response process led by the Fraud & Risk Manager. If you’re someone who digs until they have the full picture, is comfortable navigating between internal systems and external expectations, and takes pride in the quality of what they send to a bank, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Acquirer & Banking Partner Query Management • Act as the primary point of contact for inbound risk and compliance queries from Ryft’s acquiring and banking partners — managing each query through to full resolution. • Trace transactions end-to-end through Ryft’s systems in response to partner queries — reconstructing the payment journey, identifying where issues occurred, and producing clear, accurate responses that meet the bank’s expectations. • Understand what each banking partner needs to see in a response and tailor your output accordingly — whether that’s a transaction trail, a merchant explanation, supporting documentation, or a combination. • Question what you find — don’t close a query at the first plausible answer. If something looks unusual or doesn’t add up, dig further and escalate to the Fraud & Risk Manager where needed. • Maintain a clear log of all partner queries, response timelines, and outcomes, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and that patterns across queries are surfaced proactively. • Build a working knowledge of each partner’s reporting expectations, query formats, and escalation preferences, reducing friction in ongoing communications. Merchant Risk Monitoring • Carry out day-to-day merchant risk monitoring across the Ryft portfolio — reviewing transaction activity, volumes, and behavioural patterns to identify anomalies that may indicate fraud, policy breach, or elevated risk. • Feed merchant risk intelligence into the fraud detection and response process, working closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure monitoring activity informs rule tuning and threshold decisions. • Flag merchants or sub-merchants exhibiting patterns of concern, documenting your findings clearly and escalating where a risk response is required. • Support chargeback and dispute monitoring at the merchant level, identifying accounts with elevated dispute rates and feeding that data into the wider fraud analysis process. • Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of monitoring activity and risk decisions in line with FCA expectations and internal policy. Cross-functional Collaboration • Work closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure partner query intelligence and merchant monitoring findings are connected — a query from an acquirer about a specific merchant should inform, and be informed by, what you’re seeing in monitoring. • Liaise with the underwriting team where partner queries or merchant monitoring activity raises questions about how a merchant was onboarded or what their risk profile should be. • Support the engineering and product teams with information requests related to transaction tracing, where system-level investigation requires cross-functional input. • Contribute to the continuous improvement of response templates, internal runbooks, and query management procedures. What We’re Looking For Essential • Experience in a payments operations, risk operations, or financial crime role within a PSP, acquirer, payment facilitator, or bank — with direct exposure to acquirer or banking partner queries. • Demonstrable ability to trace transactions through payment systems — you understand how a payment moves, where it can go wrong, and how to reconstruct what happened from system data. • Strong written communication skills, with experience producing clear, structured responses to banking or regulatory counterparties who expect precision. • An investigative mindset — you ask the next question, not just the obvious one. You’re not satisfied with a plausible explanation if the evidence doesn’t fully support it. • Organised and reliable under query volume — able to manage multiple open cases simultaneously without losing track of timelines or detail. • Comfortable operating within a first line risk function with real accountability for the quality and timeliness of outputs. Nice to Have • Familiarity with merchant risk monitoring in a PayFac or marketplace payments model. • Experience with chargeback and dispute management, including TC40/SAFE data or scheme fraud reporting. • Exposure to fraud tooling such as Fraud.net , Sift, SEON or equivalent platforms. • SQL or data querying skills for self-serve transaction investigation. reconstructing the payment journey, identifying where issues occurred, and producing clear, accurate responses that meet the bank’s expectations.

accordingly — whether that’s a transaction trail, a merchant explanation, supporting documentation, or a combination.

escalation preferences, reducing friction in ongoing communications.

transaction activity, volumes, and behavioural patterns to identify anomalies that may indicate fraud, policy breach, or elevated risk.

closely with the Fraud & Risk Manager to ensure monitoring activity informs rule tuning and threshold decisions.

title: Frontend Engineer - Agentic AI
description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Your Mission As a Frontend Engineer at Hawk, you will build and maintain the user interface of our agentic AI Investigation Agent. This is the product where compliance analysts configure AI workflows, watch autonomous investigations run, and review, question and act on what the agent concludes. The frontend is a modern TypeScript monorepo made of a host application and a growing set of independently deployable microfrontends. These remotes are designed to be built once and used in two places: our new shadcn/ui-based Investigation Agent and our existing Material UI-based Case Manager. Your job is to understand this codebase deeply, keep it healthy, and ship new features with care, from the component level all the way to how it is built and deployed. What You'll Work On: Features: Build product features end to end in React and TypeScript, such as workflow graph editors, investigation timelines, data-heavy tables and dashboards that make agentic AI output understandable for analysts. Microfrontends: Develop and maintain Module Federation remotes, keep remote/host contracts stable, and make sure features fit into both the Investigation Agent and the MUI-based Case Manager. Design system and data layer: Contribute to our shared shadcn/ui + Tailwind component library (documented in Storybook), and consume our Python/FastAPI backends through OpenAPI-generated clients with TanStack Query and Router. Build, test and deploy: Work in a pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with GitHub Actions CI, Vitest and Playwright tests, and deployments to AWS including per-PR preview environments. Collaboration: Work closely with Product, UX, backend engineers and Data Science, and use AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor as part of your everyday workflow. Your Profile: 3–5 years building and maintaining production React applications, with strong TypeScript and modern React skills (hooks, composition, performance, complex state and forms). Clean frontend architecture: you structure code around features and clear boundaries. You keep UI components presentational and reusable, put data fetching and business logic in hooks and typed API layers, and keep server state separate from local UI state. You prefer composition, small focused components and strict typing, and you treat cross-module contracts as an API. Design-system experience: hands-on work with a component-library approach, ideally shadcn/ui, Radix and Tailwind. Familiarity with Material UI is a strong plus. Microfrontends and delivery: Module Federation or similar runtime composition, shared dependencies and host/remote contracts, plus the build and deployment basics behind them: Vite, monorepos (pnpm workspaces, Turborepo or Nx), CI pipelines (GitHub Actions) Comfort with ambiguity : you're happy working on problems that aren't fully defined yet. You ask the right questions, make sensible assumptions, build a first version and refine it with Product and UX, without waiting for a perfect spec. AI tooling: daily, practical use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.). Communication: clear communication in English, and the ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Bonus: Some Python: enough to read a FastAPI endpoint or Pydantic model, run the backend locally, trace a bug across the API boundary, or open a small backend PR. You don't need to be a backend engineer. Infrastructure as code: exposure to Terraform or AWS CDK. Quality tooling: Storybook-driven development, visual regression testing or accessibility testing. Auth: Auth0/OIDC integration in single-page apps. Domain interest: UX for AI products, or previous work in fintech, RegTech or compliance. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

This is an opportunity to build your career in communications at a fast-growing fintech that's reshaping SME finance. You'll be part of iwoca's external communications team, helping drive coverage across our expanding product portfolio, working on data-led campaigns and supporting our work with government and policymakers.

Our comms function works across the business to position iwoca as a leading voice in SME finance. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Commercial, and Executive teams to translate business priorities into compelling narratives that drive both brand awareness and customer acquisition.

The role

We're looking for a Communications Executive with up to two years' experience to join our UK comms team. Working alongside the team, you'll help publish our major data-driven campaigns, own the communications for a couple of our newest products, and support our public affairs and policy work. You'll also help with the BAU media activities that keep iwoca front-of-mind with key journalists and stakeholders.

Examples of the type of work you'll be doing:

1. Support data-driven PR campaigns

Working with the team, you'll run several established data-driven campaigns:

  • Top 25 UK Cities for SME Jobs: Our annual ranking combines ONS employment data, business figures, and economic indicators. You can refine the methodology if needed, analyse the latest data, and craft narratives for regional and national media.

  • SME survey research: Twice a year you'll help commission original survey research, working with established research partners to design questionnaires capturing timely SME sentiment. You'll help ensure we generate "business news" coverage that responds to real economic issues.

  • You'll be comfortable working with raw datasets - not just presenting finished analysis. Spotting surprising findings, identifying regional variations, understanding which angles interest journalists versus policymakers.

2. Start shouting about our new products

You'll eventually own the communications for a couple of iwoca's newest products, working directly with Venture Leads to drive awareness and customer acquisition. Here are a few we've just launched that you could be working on:

  • Credit Compass: Our credit-building tool helping SMEs improve their scores. You'll identify customer success stories, translate credit score trends into compelling narratives, and position this as iwoca's answer to the credit access gap.

iwoca works with government and policymakers to make the case for better access to finance for small businesses. You'll support this work, engaging with relevant government departments, industry bodies and ministers where relevant. This could include:

Bonus:

  • Experience in public affairs, policy or government relations, or an understanding of how policy is made.

  • Any exposure to product launches or translating complex propositions into accessible narratives.

  • Experience pitching to journalists or securing coverage in relevant press.

  • Comfortable working with senior stakeholders.

  • Commercial awareness and understanding of what drives media coverage in fintech and SME finance.

  • Familiarity with media monitoring tools (e.g., Signal AI, Cision) and ability to analyse coverage data to inform strategy.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

description: Are you an experienced doctor with a passion for developing others and delivering exceptional patient care? This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys supporting others, has experience providing clinical guidance and supervision, and is confident in building strong working relationships with clinicians and consultants. You will act as the primary link between clinicians and consultants, coordinating supervision, escalation pathways, and feedback loops so that patient care stays safe and consistent. You will combine your own clinical practice with people leadership, taking ownership of fellow development, consultant engagement, governance, and training within your team, while working alongside other Team Leads to keep standards consistent across the wider service. Identify clinicians who are struggling early, and put support plans in place in collaboration with consultants and HR/medical education leads. Assist with the onboarding and induction experience for new clinicians — inductions, shadowing, buddy systems, and early check-ins. Experience working within digital healthcare, telemedicine, private healthcare, or fast-paced healthcare environments is desirable. Comfortable using clinical systems, rostering tools, and healthcare technology platforms. Adaptable, proactive, and solutions-focused, with a genuine interest in developing junior talent. raw.description:
An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

 

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

 

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

     

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

     

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles based on experience and hours worked.

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private Healthcare

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

  • Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients)

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

 

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

title: Senior IT Asset Manager / Prozessmanager IT-Asset-Management (m/w/d)
description: Gestalte mit uns ein modernes IT-Asset-Management für die kommunale IT in Leverkusen. Du weißt, wie aus Gerätebeständen, Vertragsinformationen und vielen einzelnen Arbeitsschritten ein verlässliches IT-Asset-Management wird? Du hast bereits Prozesse neu aufgestellt und Veränderungen erfolgreich in den Arbeitsalltag gebracht? Bei uns kannst Du diese Erfahrung einbringen und einen Bereich nachhaltig weiterentwickeln. Die ivl ist der IT-Dienstleister für Leverkusen und Umgebung. Wir unterstützen die Stadtverwaltung, kommunale Unternehmen und Schulen mit leistungsfähiger IT. Unser Asset Management wollen wir fachlich, organisatorisch und technologisch neu aufstellen: mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten, belastbaren Daten und digitalen, möglichst automatisierten Abläufen. Im Rahmen einer altersbedingten Nachfolge suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Modernisierung konzipiert, gemeinsam mit unseren kaufmännischen und technischen Teams umsetzt und das Asset Management anschließend dauerhaft weiterentwickelt. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit der kaufmännischen Bereichsleitung zusammen und übernimmst fachliche Prozessverantwortung. Du möchtest gestalten und Deine Ideen im Betrieb wirksam werden lassen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Deine Aufgaben Du analysierst unsere bestehenden Prozesse, Daten und Werkzeuge im Asset Management und entwickelst daraus ein zukunftsfähiges Zielbild mit einer konkreten, priorisierten Umsetzungsplanung. Du gestaltest durchgängige Abläufe über den gesamten Lebenszyklus unserer IT-Assets – von der Beschaffung und Erfassung über die Zuordnung und Nutzung bis zur Rücknahme und Verwertung. Du klärst gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams die Zuständigkeiten und Schnittstellen zwischen Asset Management, technischer CMDB, Einkauf, IT-Betrieb, Buchhaltung und Controlling. Du etablierst einheitliche Datenstandards und verlässliche Pflegeprozesse. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass für relevante Informationen das führende System und die fachliche Verantwortung festgelegt sind. Du definierst die fachlichen Anforderungen an moderne Tools und Schnittstellen und begleitest deren Auswahl und Einführung einschließlich Datenbereinigung, Migration, Tests und Schulungen. Du sorgst dafür, dass abrechnungsrelevante Bestandsänderungen und Materialbewegungen vollständig, rechtzeitig und mit dem erforderlichen Kunden-, Vertrags- und Leistungsbezug erfasst werden. Du setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit den Kolleg um, begleitest die Einführung neuer Arbeitsweisen und stellst sicher, dass diese im Tagesgeschäft funktionieren. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität der laufenden Asset-Prozesse, unterstützt bei komplexen operativen Fragestellungen und entwickelst den Bereich anhand geeigneter Kennzahlen kontinuierlich weiter. Deine Qualifikation Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Betriebswirtschaft, oder eine kaufmännische beziehungsweise IT-bezogene Ausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung. Du bringst mehrjährige einschlägige Erfahrung im IT-Asset-Management oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen kaufmännischen Prozessen und IT-Betrieb mit. Du hast bereits die Modernisierung von Prozessen oder die Einführung eines Asset- beziehungsweise Service-Management-Systems maßgeblich verantwortet – von der Konzeption bis zum funktionierenden Regelbetrieb. Du verstehst die wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhänge von Beschaffung, Bestand, Verträgen und Abrechnung und kannst daraus praxistaugliche Anforderungen ableiten. Du kennst das Zusammenspiel von IT-Asset-Management, CMDB, IT-Service-Management und ERP-Systemen und kannst Dich mit technischen Fachleuten über Datenmodelle und Schnittstellen verständigen. Du arbeitest analytisch und strukturiert, erkennst Prioritäten und verbindest konzeptionelle Stärke mit der Bereitschaft, selbst in Daten und operative Abläufe einzusteigen. Du kommunizierst klar, moderierst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und gewinnst Kolleg für verbindliche gemeinsame Prozesse. Erfahrungen bei einem IT-Dienstleister sowie mit kundenbezogener Leistungsverrechnung sind von Vorteil. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was erwartet dich? Eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe mit Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der kaufmännischen Bereichsleitung. Bezahlung auf Grundlage des TV-V (Je nach Qualifikation EG 10 – EG 11) sowie zusätzliche Leistungen wie Weihnachtsgeld, Erfolgsbeteiligung und betriebliche Altersversorgung. Eine 39-Stunden-Woche mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung, Möglichkeiten zum Homeoffice und 30 Urlaubstagen. Ein kollegiales Umfeld, in dem wir uns duzen, offen miteinander sprechen und einander wertschätzen. Gute Erreichbarkeit mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, kostenfreie Parkmöglichkeiten und JobRad. Angebote für Deine Gesundheit und ergonomisch ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze. Wir möchten Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen und Perspektiven für die ivl gewinnen. Entscheidend sind Deine Fähigkeiten und Deine Motivation – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Familienstand. Auch eine Besetzung in Teilzeit ist grundsätzlich möglich. Bewerbungen von Frauen begrüßen wir ausdrücklich; bei gleicher Eignung werden sie nach Maßgabe des LGG NRW bevorzugt berücksichtigt. raw.description:
Headquarters: Remote - Ireland

About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Customer Solutions Engineer to join the Technical Account Management team. This role gives Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long-term, dedicated Technical Account Manager. Customer Solutions Engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with CSMs for the duration of a specific need, triggered by things like recurring support cases, asks beyond the typical support experience, or short-term project-based work. The ideal candidate combines deep technical fluency with strong triage judgment and is comfortable moving between engagements without an existing playbook.

What you will do 

  • Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.
  • Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM.
  • Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.
  • Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.
  • Document session recaps and next steps in the CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.
  • Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.
  • Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off.
  • Surface patterns across engagements to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive systemic improvement.

Must Haves 

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role (email infrastructure, IT security/administration, engineering, or technical support) in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity
  • Solid grounding in Abnormal's platform and configuration best practices, sufficient to work independently with customers without a senior technical resource in the room
  • Strong triage judgment; able to recognize quickly whether a situation calls for hands-on technical guidance or a more senior technical resource
  • Comfortable stepping into a customer relationship for a defined engagement and stepping back out; this is not a standing account-ownership role
  • Able to manage multiple concurrent, time-bound engagements across a broad book of business rather than a fixed set of named accounts
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and business stakeholders, including comfort presenting to senior customer stakeholders

Nice to Have 

  • Familiarity with email authentication/delivery protocols and cloud email platforms (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace)
  • Prior experience in a floating/pooled technical resource model (e.g., professional services, deployment, or solutions engineering)
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience

description:

As our Senior Customer Success Executive, you’ll:

Join our global revenue team, reporting to the VP Customer Success - Midmarket, and take ownership of retention and engagement for GWI’s Essentials portfolio: 250 accounts worldwide. You’ll work alongside one other Customer Success Executive to build and run the strategy for keeping these customers engaged, getting real value from our data, and renewing. You’ll have real ownership of the portfolio: you’ll set the engagement strategy, decide which accounts need which kind of attention, and track which actions improve retention.

A few things you’ll be responsible for:

  • Owning retention outcomes for the portfolio (churn, renewal rate, and NPS), supporting the renewal process, and partnering with Sales and Account Management to secure renewals and surface expansion opportunities
  • Using usage and account data to spot at-risk accounts early, and building and carrying out plans to keep them before renewal conversations begin
  • Designing and running the CS communications programme for all Essentials clients, including campaigns, webinars, and in-app and email touchpoints that drive adoption and usage at scale
  • Guiding users over email, live chat, and video calls, and handling user and account administration
  • Turning customer feedback into action by sharing it with Product, Marketing, and Channel teams
  • Continuously improving how we scale by testing new approaches, automating where it makes sense, and sharing what works
  • Keeping Salesforce accurate by logging all activity and engagements

What do I need to bring with me? 🧳

  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or another client-facing role where you were responsible for retention, renewals, or customer engagement, ideally looking after a large number of accounts through a scaled approach
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail: you’re comfortable using usage data to find risk and opportunity, and can turn it into a story that you present confidently to customers and colleagues
  • Clear, engaging written and verbal communication, including writing customer-facing content
  • You prioritise well across many accounts, notice what isn’t working, suggest a better way, and follow through
  • Strong working relationships across teams are second nature to you, whether with Sales, Product, or Marketing
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

What We Offer 🧘

At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:

  • Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.
  • Health & wellbeing – Private Medical Insurance, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.
  • Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.
  • Flexibility & balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.
  • Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.
  • Community & impact – DE&I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.

Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🫶

Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.

As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.

We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.

At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.

Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

  • Data. Define the data we need to measure and improve our models.

  • Model releases. Co-lead new model releases. You own the quality go/no-go and the capability claims.

  • PM experience (product or research) working directly on generative models. You've shaped the model itself rather than building features on top of it.

  • Strong judgment on trade-offs made with incomplete signal, and the drive to own prioritization end to end.

  • Comfort in an ambiguous, fast-changing research environment, where the right priority shifts as the model and harness evolve.

  • Defined what a generative model should get better at, and got a research team to act on it.

  • Turned a messy backlog of model weaknesses into ranked priorities that survived contact with a research org. Sources might include bug reports, leaderboard gaps, and customer complaints.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

title: Senior AI Researcher: LLM post-training for hallucination reduction (f/m/d)
description: Who we are Aleph Alpha’s mission is to deliver sovereign, human-centric AI to governmental institutions and large enterprises. To that end, we deliver category-defining AI innovation that enables open, accessible, and trustworthy deployment of GenAI in industrial applications. Our organization develops foundational models and next-generation methods that make it easy and affordable for Aleph Alpha’s customers to increase productivity in development, engineering, logistics, and manufacturing processes. About the role We are looking for a (Senior) AI Researcher to join our hallucination reduction capability team to push the boundaries in LLM post-training (SFT and RL). We're one of the few places in Europe training foundation models from scratch. You will be part of a team of (senior) researchers and PhD interns doing cutting-edge research across pre-, mid- and post-training, grounding and specialized models with hundreds of GPUs at our disposal. What will you do Core Research & Development: Design, execute, and scale post-training methodologies (SFT, RL) specifically aimed at eliminating model hallucinations and making them grounded in evidence. Uncertainty & Reliability: Research and implement techniques in uncertainty estimation, calibration, self-consistency, and self-correction mechanisms to enable models to identify and signal when they “don't know”. Post-Training Pipelines: Build and optimize high-throughput, distributed fine-tuning and training pipelines across multi-node GPU clusters. Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design and implement rigorous evaluation methods to benchmark hallucination rates, truthfulness, and reasoning accuracy. Technical Ownership: Drive research projects independently from initial hypothesis to scalable production implementation and technical reports. Qualifications Hands-on experience fine-tuning or post-training LLMs using modern distributed training frameworks. Track record of research or implementation in at least one of the following domains: Hallucination mitigation / truthfulness alignment / grounding in RAG Uncertainty estimation, or out-of-distribution detection Retrieval-Augmented Generation evaluation / alignment, refusal behavior calibration, or claim verification Strong programming skills (Python & PyTorch). title: Expert Financial Performance & Value Creation (m/w/d)
description: Die Chance Steuerberatungen rechnen rückwärts. Sie wissen genau, was im letzten Jahr passiert ist, und erstaunlich wenig darüber, welches Mandat, welche Leistung und welcher Mitarbeiter morgen Geld verdient. Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen aus dem Bestand und durch Übernahmen. Beides stellt dieselbe Frage in zwei Formen: Was verdienen unsere Mandate, Leistungen und Teams tatsächlich, und was folgt daraus für die nächsten zwölf Monate. Die Rolle ist auf ein bis drei Jahre Beratungserfahrung zugeschnitten. Du treibst die finanzielle Steuerung von der Ertragsseite her. Du siehst auf die Zahlen, erkennst, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, und gehst damit zu den Menschen, die es ändern können, auch wenn das Gespräch unangenehm wird. So lange, bis die Wirkung in den Zahlen steht. Du berichtest an Moritz Bonacker. Was du verantwortest Ertragskraft und Produktivität Durchleuchte die Bestände auf den echten Daten des laufenden Rechnungswesens, von der Mandatsgröße bis zum Deckungsbeitrag, und mach sichtbar, was heute stillschweigend miterbracht und nicht abgerechnet wird. Bewerte die Produktivität auf beiden Seiten: je Leistungsart, welche ihren Deckungsbeitrag trägt und welche quersubventioniert wird, und je Mitarbeiter, wo Wertschöpfung je eingesetzter Stunde entsteht. Dein Maßstab: keine Analyse ohne benannte Maßnahme, benannten Verantwortlichen und benanntes Datum. Durchsetzung Führ die Honorargespräche selbst oder mit einem Berufsträger an deiner Seite. Und sprich auch die unangenehmen Fälle aus: Nicht jedes Mandat hat einen Weg in die Profitabilität. Geh mit deinen Zahlen direkt zu den fachlich Verantwortlichen: was ihre Mandate und Teams produzieren, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, was sich konkret ändern muss. Verfolge die Maßnahmen nach, bis das Ergebnis in den Zahlen steht. Auch wenn es unbequem wird. Zukauf und Vorausschau Entwickle je Übernahme den Wertsteigerungsplan auf der finanziellen Seite und verfolge ihn über Jahre statt über hundert Tage. Dein Maßstab: Die dritte Übernahme läuft besser als die erste, weil du beide gemacht hast. Verantworte Umsatz- und Ergebnisprognose, Budgets, Szenarien und Abweichungsanalysen über alle Standorte, auch die neu dazugekommenen. Automatisiere, was du baust. Keine Auswertung, die jemand monatlich manuell zusammensetzt. Fragen, auf die du die Antwort findest Ein Mandat trägt seinen Deckungsbeitrag nicht, die Beziehung besteht seit fünfzehn Jahren: Wie gehst du in dieses Gespräch, und wo ist deine Grenze? Woran unterscheidest du eine Leistung, die zu billig ist, von einer, die zu aufwendig erbracht wird? Deine Empfehlung wird von jemandem blockiert, der dir nicht berichtet. Was tust du, wenn das zweite Gespräch auch nichts bringt? Woran wir Erfolg messen Nach 6 Monaten: Der erste Bestand ist vollständig durchgerechnet, Deckungsbeitrag je Mandat und Leistungsart liegen belastbar vor, die erste Auswertung läuft automatisiert, die ersten Honorargespräche hast du selbst geführt. Nach 12 Monaten: Die erste Anpassungswelle ist über den Bestand gefahren, das erreichte Honorarniveau nachgewiesen. Die Deckungsbeitragsrechnung wird in Führungsentscheidungen verwendet. Deine Prognose trägt, ihre Abweichung kannst du erklären. Nach 24 Monaten: Mehrere Übernahmen begleitet, die spätere lief nachweislich besser als die erste. Die Steuerung läuft weitgehend automatisiert, dein Anteil hat sich von der Aufbereitung zur Interpretation verschoben. Wohin es führt: in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn, mit größerem Themenfeld und mehr methodischer Autorität. Willst du ein Team aufbauen, steht dir die Führungslaufbahn ebenso offen. Entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr. Was du mitbringst Du hast ein bis drei Jahre in der Beratung gearbeitet, in der Strategieberatung, in Transaction Services oder in einem Wertsteigerungs-Team: kommerzielle Prüfung, Pricing, Ergebnisverbesserung. Du hast Profitabilität auf Kunden-, Produkt- oder Leistungsebene gerechnet und die Ergebnisse gegenüber Entscheidern vertreten, nicht nur aufbereitet. Du führst unangenehme Gespräche, statt sie aufzuschieben, ob es um Geld oder um Leistung geht, und hältst deine Position, wenn Widerspruch kommt. Du beherrschst Excel jenseits von Pivot-Tabellen und liest eine Buchführung, ohne Steuerberater zu sein. SQL oder Python sind kein Zusatz, sondern der Weg, dieselbe Auswertung nicht zweimal von Hand zu bauen. Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Datenanalyse, Mustererkennung in Bestandsdaten und Drafting. Du bewegst Menschen ohne Weisungsbefugnis, über eine Rechnung, die niemand bestreiten kann, und über einen Ton, der Widerstand nicht erzeugt. Und du setzt in allem den höchsten Standard, weil Mittelmaß für dich keine Option ist. Ein Plus, keine Bedingung Erfahrung aus einem Wertsteigerungsprogramm nach einer Übernahme. Dass du es nie selbst zu Ende umgesetzt hast, ist kein Ausschluss, genau das ist hier die Aufgabe. Nähe zur Steuerberatung oder zu einer anderen Dienstleistung, die in Stunden verkauft wird. Kein kanonischer Lebenslauf nötig: Steuerberater mit ausgeprägter Zahlen- und Preisneigung, Bank- oder Beteiligungsprofil mit Wunsch nach einer operativen Rolle, Praxismanager, der eine Einheit nachweislich auf Deckungsbeitrag umgestellt hat. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala: Das obere Ende steht für den Umfang des verantworteten Themenfelds und für die Fähigkeit, Menschen ohne Weisungsbefugnis zu bewegen. Ein anderer Hintergrund startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau. Was diese Rolle ist, und was nicht Rechnen und sprechen, nicht abgeben. Du gibst das Ergebnis nicht ab, du führst das Gespräch darüber. Wäre das eine Excel-Rolle, wäre sie falsch geschnitten. Entscheidungen tragen, nicht dokumentieren. Jede Zahl, die du baust, muss eine Entscheidung tragen. Monatsabschluss-Kommentierung ohne Konsequenz gibt es hier nicht. Überzeugen, nicht anweisen. Die Berufsträger und Teams, mit denen du arbeitest, berichten nicht an dich. Wer Widerstand über Hierarchie löst, kommt hier nicht weit. Warum Vogel Die Frage ist im Markt ungelöst. Kaum ein Haus dieser Branche kennt seinen Deckungsbeitrag je Mandat. Du baust die Antwort. Du siehst, was aus deiner Empfehlung wird. Hier begleitest du dieselben Mandate über Jahre, statt nach der Abgabe zu gehen. Du willst entscheiden: Methode, Kennzahlen und Reihenfolge. Kein Gremium überstimmt dich. Vogel ist hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation, autonom in der Ausführung. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt. Substanz im Rücken. Ein profitables, wachsendes Unternehmen mit etablierten Mandanten. Was du verbesserst, wirkt auf eine Basis, die bereits trägt. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick. 3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values. 6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es? Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig.
