title: 2027 Graduate Software Engineer - Healthcare (2027 start)
description:
Introduction

We are looking for bright graduates with a passion for software and a curiosity for how things work and how technology can help us solve problems.  

You will join our embedded software team and contribute to the development of innovative technologies for healthcare devices.

Candidates can start between May–October 2027.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

 

What we do

Each project we undertake is different, and at the cutting edge of technology. This means we can't talk about much of our ongoing work, but here are some examples of completed projects that we are excited to share:

  • An emergency-use ventilator, developed in just over six weeks in response to the government’s Ventilator Challenge  
  • A neurostimulation device allowing treatment to improve, or even restore, someone’s ability to walk  
  • An autoinjector capable of delivering a wide range of drugs, while being intuitive to use and beautiful to look at  

 

 

What you'll be doing

From day one, you’ll be part of our multidisciplinary medical development team, tackling real technical problems while receiving guidance and training from experienced engineers. You’ll gain access to designing and developing embedded software to a high standard. You will be part of a team developing technologies that can make a meaningful difference to people’s lives.

Within your role you'll likely: 

  • Design, develop, and test embedded software for complex medical systems used in diagnostic, surgical, implantable device, and drug-delivery applications.
  • Contribute to a wide range of projects that span the full software development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary and supportive team, gaining exposure to systems involving electronics, optics, fluidics, robotics, and user-interface components.
  • Work with industry best practices such as continuous integration, automated testing and analysis, and model-based systems engineering.

 

 

What You Can Bring

Application requirements

To apply for this role you must:

  • Be currently completing or have recent completed a degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics.
  • Have experience programming in C.

The most important technical skill for this role is programming in C.

The following skills and experience are advantageous:

  • Experience with other languages such as Rust, Python or C++
  • Working in a team using version control (ideally Git) and peer code reviews
  • Contributing to open-source software
  • Unit testing or other verification techniques
  • Experience developing embedded software
  • Knowledge of electronics and controlling peripherals using interfaces such as UART/I2C/SPI
  • Signal processing and/or control theory
  • Data science and/or AI

Knowledge of biology or medical subjects is not a requirement, though you should be enthusiastic about applying your technical skills to this field of application.

 

Your CV should include all your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, where applicable, as well as university modules, coursework, projects or other experience that demonstrates your relevant skills.

A covering statement is welcome but is not required.

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets.

Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées.

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

  • Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles

  • Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

  • Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

  • Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %)

  • Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

  • Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

Plans et documentation de production (10 %)

  • Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés

  • Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage

  • Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage

Essais (5 %)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

  • Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres)

  • Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages

  • Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer

  • Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4)

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices)

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié)

  • Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense

Qualités personnelles

  • Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite"

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe

  • Faire évoluer les prototypes validés vers une version industrialisable en appliquant les principes DFM / DFA (conception pour la fabrication et l'assemblage)

  • Optimiser les pièces et sous-ensembles : masse, coût, nombre de pièces, temps de fabrication, choix des procédés et matériaux de série

  • Participer à la rédaction les gammes de montage et les instructions d'assemblage

  • Réaliser les schémas de câblage et la documentation électrique associée

  • Constituer le dossier de définition du produit : plans, nomenclatures, tolérances

Intégration et dimensionnement électronique (5%)

  • Participer au choix et au dimensionnement des composants embarqués (motorisation, ESC, batteries, contrôleur de vol, capteurs, câblage) selon les contraintes du prototype : masse, encombrement, consommation, thermique

  • Prévoir dans la CAO l'implantation des cartes et composants, le passage des câbles, le refroidissement et l'accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Assembler, câbler et réaliser les premiers tests d'intégration pour valider le fonctionnement des prototypes

  • Configurer et paramétrer les systèmes via Mission Planner (calibrations, paramètres, check avant vols)

Essais et documentation (5%)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : tests au banc, tests au sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Documenter les conceptions, les choix techniques et les résultats d'essais

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement de ses travaux à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Étudiant(e) de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, licence professionnelle, master) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique, mécatronique ou équivalent

  • Stage (idéalement de fin d'études)

Compétences techniques

  • Très bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion

  • Connaissance des règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; la pratique d'OrcaSlicer (ou d'un autre slicer) est appréciée

  • Notions de résistance des matériaux, de tolérancement et de choix des matériaux (PLA, PETG, ASA, nylon, composites chargés)

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, alimentation et puissance, dimensionnement de composants, soudure et câblage

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4) est un gros plus

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices) est un plus

  • Profil mécatronique, capable de faire le lien entre mécanique, électronique et logiciel

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D

  • Un intérêt pour les environnements aéronautique, spatial ou défense est apprécié

Qualités personnelles

  • Curiosité et goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on »

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et capacité à travailler en équipe

title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights . About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality. Context and role Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals. This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member. Thought Leadership Development Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar. Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions. Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects. Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap. Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation. Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence. Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality. Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets. Thought Leadership Communication Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis. Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market. Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap. Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content. Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics. Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive. Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences. Market Intelligence Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG. Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership. Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output. Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work. Competitive Analysis Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors. Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available. Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings. Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence. Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position. Industry Analysis Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments). Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings). Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients. Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes. Internal Dissemination and Application Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap. Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities. Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities. Requirements What will you bring along? Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment. Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus. Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events. Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority. An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies. Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations. Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities. Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends. Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour. Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets. Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content. Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team. Experience managing or coaching at least one team member. Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

As we grow our EMEA team, we are seeking a Sales Development Representative for the Nordics region, based in the UK or NL. This role will require you to be in our London/Amsterdam office 3-4 times per week.

  • You sell a world-class product that helps people
  • Offering a cool thing you know works (check our Success Stories)
  • You’re in touch with C-level clients and leading e-commerce businesses
  • Having a job in the world’s most progressive industry
  • You can make a killing (generous commission including on every signed deal)
  • The sales role is the launchpad to the fastest career growth at Bloomreach (both in terms of responsibilities and salary)
  • As a salesperson, you have an incredible variety – vertically (you can sell different elements of the platform depending on the client’s immediate needs) and horizontally (you can choose your clients by industry – Fashion, Travel, Food Delivery, etc.)

Main goals of this role:

  • Generating new business leads, following up on MQLs & converting to SQLs.
  • Cold calling potential customers and building relationships.
  • Identifying customer needs and selling products accordingly.
  • Working with weekly, monthly, quarterly sales targets and KPI’s.
  • Arranging meetings with clients and carrying out product demonstrations.
  • Following up swiftly on sales enquiries and sending out information.
  • Working closely with other teams to develop new business.
  • Researching the market and identifying potential target customers (ICPs).
  • Attending industry events in order to generate business leads.

What we expect of you:

  • Previous new business experience ideally from a company in the same or similar industry is ideal
  • Proven track record of bringing new business and a natural ability to drive sales
  • Must be self-motivated, trustworthy and with a strong desire to succeed
  • Well organised with experience using CRM systems (Salesforce, Hubspot, Salesloft)
  • Excellent time management skills, Positive attitude and “love of selling”
  • A team attitude is absolutely necessary
  • A creativity over activity mentality when it comes to outbound prospecting

#LI-SF1

€37.632—€47.040 EUR

title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

 

Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation

Location: Amsterdam ( preferred), or London
Reports to: Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead
Role type: Full-time

Role Overview

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

This is a senior leadership role combining:

  • Deep power systems expertise
  • Top-tier strategy problem solving
  • Origination and senior client leadership
  • Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes
  • Team leadership and platform-building

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities

Power Systems & Grid Transformation

  • Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.
  • Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.
  • Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.
  • Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.

Strategic Advisory

  • Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.
  • Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.
  • Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.

Systems Change & Platform Leadership

  • Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.
  • Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.
  • Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.
  • Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.

Origination & Growth

  • Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor high-performing teams.
  • Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.

Essential Experience

  • Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy
  • Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory
  • Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.
  • Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.
  • Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.
  • Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.
  • Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.

Core Capabilities

  • Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.
  • Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.
  • Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.
  • Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.
  • Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.
  • Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.

Mindset

  • Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.
  • Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.
  • Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.

Why This Role Matters

Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.

This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.

Diversity & Inclusion
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.

description:
Für unseren Projektstandort in Visp suchen wir einen Qualifizierungsingenieur (w/m/d) mit Eintrittstermin nach Absprache.

Deine Aufgaben

Seit 1957 sind wir Vorreiter in den Bereichen Design, Engineering und Projektmanagement. Benefits

title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

About the role

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.
  • Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.
  • Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.
  • Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.
  • Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.
  • Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.
  • Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.
  • Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.
  • Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.
  • Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of:

  • HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.
  • HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.
  • JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.
  • Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.
  • Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.
  • txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.
  • Structured data and Schema.org.
  • Core Web Vitals and web performance.
  • International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.
  • Website and platform migrations.
  • Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

  • Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.
  • Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.
  • Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.
  • Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.
  • Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.
  • Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.
  • Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.
  • Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.
  • Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.
  • Strong experience working with large and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.
  • Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.
  • A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.
  • An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.
  • Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 
 
Our compensation: 

  • A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.
  • Hybrid working flexibility.
  • Access to learning platforms .
  • Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. 
  • Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 
  • Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. 
  • At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. 

 

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

  • Act as the Primary Strategic & Technical Authority: Serve as the trusted sparring partner for senior client leads, translating business requirements into scalable MarTech strategies across Salesforce, Braze, Bloomreach, Klaviyo, and peripheral technologies.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

💰 Our Finance team

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), and Procurement. This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO.

 

✨ Why this role is special

Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies.

  • You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on.

  • A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone.

  • International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands.

 

🎯 What you will do

As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting), your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard;

  • Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time;

  • Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control;

  • Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework;

  • Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury;

  • Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners, and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness;

  • Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls, working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales.

 

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up.

  • Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus.

  • Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position.

  • International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus.

  • Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable.

  • Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things.

  • AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition.

  • Languages: Fluent French and English.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

title: Process Automation Engineer
description: Functieprofiel Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software). Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners. Bedrijfsomschrijving NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie. Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste. Wat ga jij doen! In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met: Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3) Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein Wat wij vragen! Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering: Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen Wat bieden wij jou! Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd. Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities. title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
description: Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Word jij blij van de afwisseling en uitdaging van een projectmatige rol en met de zekerheid en voordelen van een baan in loondienst? Dan is deze rol als interim manager bij Cordaan iets voor jou! Wat ga je doen? Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. Jouw belangrijkste taken: Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving. Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek. Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop. description: DNW zoekt een teamleider die ICT en security samenbrengt: iemand die zorgt dat onze medewerkers goed kunnen werken, onze systemen betrouwbaar beschikbaar zijn en onze informatie veilig blijft. title: Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter
description: Bouw mee aan recruitment voor een hoogwaardige tech consultancy Senior tech professionals vinden vraagt meer dan vacatures publiceren en sollicitaties beoordelen. De beste kandidaten zijn vaak niet actief op zoek. Je moet weten waar je ze vindt, hoe je ze benadert en hoe je ze enthousiast maakt voor een inhoudelijk gesprek. Bij Conflux zoeken we daarom een Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter die recruitment en sourcing beheerst. Iemand die zelfstandig de arbeidsmarkt benadert, hiring managers adviseert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het volledige recruitmentproces. Conflux is een Nederlandse tech consultancy met gespecialiseerde expertise binnen onder andere Data & AI, Software Development, Cloud en Platform Engineering. Onze consultants werken aan complexe technische vraagstukken en behoren inhoudelijk tot de ervaren professionals binnen hun vakgebied. Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. We zoeken onder andere Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Java Developers, Kubernetes Engineers, Platform Engineers en Front-end Developers. Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat. Wat je gaat doen Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere: Data Engineering & AI Machine Learning Java Development Kubernetes & Cloud Native Cloud & Platform Engineering Front-end Development Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding. raw.title: Senior Azure Platform Engineer
raw.description:
Als Senior Azure Platform Engineer bij Conflux Consulting help je organisaties bij het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van moderne cloud-native platformen op Microsoft Azure en Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Je opereert op het snijvlak van platform engineering, cloud, infrastructuur, Kubernetes en DevOps.


Je bent niet alleen uitvoerend sterk, maar ook inhoudelijk richtinggevend. Je adviseert klanten over platformarchitectuur, containerisatie, cloud governance, security, automation en schaalbaarheid. Je bouwt productieklare Azure- en AKS-platformen waarop development- en engineeringteams veilig, betrouwbaar en zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig kunnen werken.


Daarbij kijk je verder dan individuele Azure-services. Je denkt vanuit het platform als geheel: hoe standaardiseren en automatiseren we infrastructuur? title: Senior Recruiter
description: Wij zoeken geen recruiter die wacht op sollicitaties. adesso Nederland groeit. En de mensen die wij zoeken, zijn meestal niet actief op zoek naar een nieuwe baan. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Recruiter die recruitment écht beheerst. Iemand die begrijpt dat een vacature online zetten het begin is en niet de strategie. Je weet hoe je zelf de markt in gaat. Je searcht, sourcet, benadert en bouwt relaties op. Je probeert verschillende invalshoeken als een search niet werkt. Je kent LinkedIn Recruiter, maar weet ook dat sourcing meer is dan een paar zoektermen invoeren en InMails versturen. En misschien nog belangrijker: je hebt ideeën. Over waar we talent kunnen vinden. Over hoe we mensen kunnen benaderen. Over employer branding. Over onze propositie als werkgever. Over tooling, data, events, referrals, communities en alles wat ons kan helpen om betere mensen aan adesso te verbinden. Zie je een kans? Dan verwachten we niet dat je wacht tot iemand je vertelt wat je moet doen. Je pakt hem. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt verantwoordelijkheid voor recruitment binnen adesso Nederland en werkt nauw samen met hiring managers en management. Daarbij ben je zowel strategisch als operationeel. Want senior zijn betekent bij ons niet dat je alleen adviseert. Je doet het ook zelf. Je: voert zelfstandig searches uit naar schaarse IT-professionals; bouwt talentpools op in plaats van pas te zoeken zodra er een vacature ontstaat; benadert kandidaten persoonlijk en weet hun interesse te wekken; experimenteert met nieuwe sourcingkanalen en manieren van benaderen; voert intakes met hiring managers en durft kritisch te zijn op het profiel dat zij zoeken; adviseert over haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, salaris en recruitmentstrategie; voert gesprekken met kandidaten en begeleidt het proces van eerste contact tot hire; houdt overzicht over je vacatures en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat; gebruikt data om te begrijpen wat wel en niet werkt; komt zelf met voorstellen om recruitment slimmer en effectiever te maken; denkt mee over employer branding, referral recruitment, events en communities; bouwt mee aan hoe recruitment binnen adesso Nederland zich verder ontwikkelt. Je krijgt daarbij geen dichtgetimmerd recruitmenthandboek. We verwachten juist dat jij vanuit je ervaring kunt zeggen: “Dit werkt niet. Ik denk dat we het zo moeten aanpakken.” En vervolgens help je om het te realiseren. Wanneer ben je voor ons senior? Niet omdat er ‘Senior Recruiter’ op je LinkedIn-profiel staat. Voor ons zit senioriteit in hoe je werkt. Je hoeft niet gevraagd te worden om te sourcen je weet dat het onderdeel van je vak is. Als een search niets oplevert, concludeer je niet dat “de markt lastig is”. Je verandert je aanpak. Als een hiring manager een onrealistisch profiel zoekt, durf je dat gesprek te voeren. Als je ziet dat ons recruitmentproces beter kan, kom je niet alleen met het probleem maar ook met een voorstel. En als je een goed idee hebt, krijg je energie van het daadwerkelijk uitvoeren ervan. We zoeken iemand met stevige recruitmentervaring, bij voorkeur binnen IT, tech of consultancy. Maar het aantal jaren ervaring vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je daadwerkelijk kunt. We willen vooral zien dat je: aantoonbaar sterk bent in search, sourcing en direct benaderen; weet hoe je schaarse senior professionals vindt en interesseert; verschillende sourcingstrategieën kunt bedenken én uitvoeren; creatief bent in het vinden van nieuwe kandidaten en doelgroepen; verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je vacatures en resultaten; zelfstandig prioriteiten stelt; hiring managers als volwaardig gesprekspartner adviseert; kritisch durft te zijn wanneer dat nodig is; nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe recruitmenttechnieken, tooling en AI; met data naar je eigen recruitmentfunnel kijkt; ideeën niet alleen bedenkt, maar ook uitvoert; Nederlands en Engels professioneel beheerst. Wat je bij ons niet hoeft te doen Wachten tot iemand je vertelt welke Boolean search je moet gebruiken. Wachten tot marketing met een employer-brandingidee komt. Wachten tot een hiring manager vraagt waarom een vacature al zes weken openstaat. Of iedere week uitleggen dat de markt nu eenmaal moeilijk is. Natuurlijk is de IT-arbeidsmarkt moeilijk. Dat is precies waarom we een goede Senior Recruiter zoeken. Wat krijg je daarvoor terug? Veel vrijheid. Maar vrijheid betekent bij ons ook verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt de ruimte om recruitment mede vorm te geven en nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. adesso werkt met korte lijnen, veel autonomie en ruimte voor initiatief. Onze Culture Code draait onder andere om hands-on, straightforward en open-minded werken . Dat betekent: aanpakken, zeggen wat je denkt en openstaan voor betere ideeën. Verder kun je rekenen op: een vast dienstverband voor 32–40 uur per week; 27 vakantiedagen; 4 studiedagen per jaar; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar; een mobiliteitsregeling; hybride werken en flexibele werktijden; een goede pensioenregeling en aanvullende verzekeringen; internationale ontwikkelmogelijkheden binnen adesso; en vooral: ruimte om recruitment beter neer te zetten. Klinkt dit bekend? Misschien zie je tijdens het lezen van deze vacature al drie dingen die je anders zou doen. Mooi. Dan zijn we waarschijnlijk naar jou op zoek. We zoeken geen recruiter die onze huidige manier van werken netjes in stand houdt. We zoeken iemand die helpt om hem beter te maken. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Deze rol vereist een individu die zich moeiteloos kan aanpassen aan diverse projecten en klantbehoeften, en zakelijke successen kan stimuleren door middel van effectieve datastrategieën. Als Data & Strategy Consultant bij adesso speel je een cruciale rol in het helpen van onze klanten om het volledige potentieel van hun data te benutten. Deze functie vraagt om een professional die niet alleen de fijne kneepjes van datamanagement begrijpt, maar ook uitblinkt in projectmanagement en business development. Jouw primaire verantwoordelijkheid zal zijn om de kloof te overbruggen tussen technische data-oplossingen en zakelijke doelstellingen, zodat onze klanten weloverwogen, data-gedreven beslissingen kunnen nemen. Workshops en bijeenkomsten faciliteren om eisen te verzamelen, bevindingen te presenteren en actiegerichte strategieën aan te bevelen. Samenwerken met het verkoopteam om verkoopstrategieën te ontwikkelen en uit te voeren die aansluiten bij de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. We zoeken niet iemand die ieder vinkje op een technologielijst kan zetten. Maar we verwachten niet dat je alles al hebt gedaan. · Microsoft Fabric; · Azure Databricks; · Azure Data Factory; · Snowflake; · Apache Spark / PySpark; · Delta Lake; · Power BI; · Collibra of andere data governance-oplossingen; · Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry of andere AI-services binnen Azure; · Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform of Bicep. Data & AI bij adesso Data is bij ons geen losstaand onderdeel van een project. Het is steeds vaker de basis waarop nieuwe digitale oplossingen worden gebouwd. Binnen ons Data & AI-team werken Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers en andere specialisten samen aan oplossingen die verder gaan dan alleen dashboards of losse modellen. Van moderne dataplatformen en machine learning tot generative AI en agentic AI: we willen technologie niet alleen interessant vinden, maar vooral werkend krijgen bij onze klanten. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure. Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model: Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware. Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down. Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases. Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required). Decathlon aims to become the best sports digital platform and open ecosystem in the world. We want to enable customers to experience Decathlon through many local sport-centric experiences by connecting many third-party actors and services, in a secure and performant way.

With a presence in more than 70 countries, Decathlon is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.

Job Description

Our PRISM (Supply Chain) is looking for an AI Engineer based in Paris. As an AI Engineer dedicated to agent deployment, you will be at the heart of a tight-knit technical team. Your will play a critical role in the industrialization, deployment and monitoring of our Agent capabilities. You will closely work with digital teams (Data, Product, Engineering) to architect the deployment infrastructure, design intelligence routing, and build secure infrastructure allowing our agents to interact natively with our corporate data and legacy systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy solid foundations that will allow our AI agents to be hosted, run, and interact smoothly with our systems during production release.
  • Design robust pipelines enabling multi-step asynchronous agentic execution (e.g., transactional ingestion and writing flows), by implementing distributed resilience patterns.
  • Integrate agentic orchestration SDKs (notably Google Vertex AI Agent SDK / ADK), bypassing "black box" limitations of managed frameworks.
  • Efficiently orchestrate agents in production while ensuring proper information processing, routing to the most suitable models, and guaranteeing optimal cost and token usage management. Also ensure quality and speed of task execution.
  • Strictly define the scope of action for each agent. You guarantee they only access data and actions for which they are formally authorized, respecting our confidentiality rules, while ensuring data security.
  • Build advanced performance measurement and tracking pipelines to trace agent reflections and decisions from end to end in order to debug logic in production.
  • Work with the team to define relevant and consistent data evaluation metrics relative to the defined functional specificities and metrics.

Hard Skills

  • Robust backend design (Python), operational mastery of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and pipelines (CI/CD, automated testing, observability, log management) to ensure robust production releases.
  • Production-focused Python expertise, mastery of deployment platforms (Vertex AI Agent Builder, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) and client/server integration protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience optimizing context windows for massive frontier models. Request routing to models suitable for the selected solutions.
  • Ability to build test frameworks for LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, Golden Datasets), mastery of deterministic metrics and strict validation of output formats (JSON schema enforcement).
  • Practical experience with Agentic RAG, Semantic Caching to reduce latency and API costs, or using prompt optimization frameworks (e.g., DSPy)
  • Applied experience in supply chain, retail technology, or model deployment via Databricks / MLFlow

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies and share them.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable terms for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand user challenges and associated needs.

Qualifications

  • Senior Profile: You have solid experience (Machine Learning Engineering) with a strong focus on production infrastructure release.
  • Ability to leverage managed solutions (Vertex AI) while knowing how to "dive into code" to debug distributed architectures, develop custom connectors, and bypass framework limitations.
  • Demonstrated ability to evolve in shifting technical environments.
  • Operational skills on GCP and understanding of containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) to autonomously deploy the Agentic layer.

Technical Environment

  • Agent orchestration: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI Agent Builder
  • Infrastructure & Cloud: GCP (Google Cloud Platform), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines.
  • AI & Integration Protocols: Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMs (Gemini), LLM routing & memory management.
  • Security & Access: Google Cloud Model Armor.
  • Execution Engine: Databricks, AWS EKS, Sagemaker
  • Payload: Python, Spark, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow / Pytorch, Pyspark 
  • CICD: Github Actions
  • Serving: Docker, Protobuf, gRPC
  • Model registry, Model Tracking: MLFlow
  • Orchestration:  Airflow
  • Documentation / code: Git, Confluence 
  • Data Visualisation: Tableau

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems

  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

title: Associate Director, HEOR & Market Access, EU West
description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
 
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
 
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Senior Director, Head of Market Access, EU West Region and work closely with Medical affairs, Market Access, Commercial locally and globally, to support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic rare diseases.

You will own the value demonstration strategy for our products across the region, and translate it into effective patient access: design each product's evidence generation plan, drive it through to delivery, and align it with pricing and access strategy, starting in France, then extending to the other countries of the EU West region

Your main responsibilities include:

Evidence generation

  • Design and lead natural history studies, cohorts, registries, and analyses of medico-administrative databases (SNDS, BNDMR/ BaMaRa, rare disease network registries)
  • Lead indirect comparisons in the context of single-arm trials and very small patient populations
  • Develop health economic models (cost-effectiveness, budget impact) for France, then for other markets in the region
  • Design real-world data collection frameworks (PUT-RD / data collection protocols) that can be reused for reassessment and in other countries
  • Define the scientific publication and communication plan

Study management

  • Draft specifications, run tenders, and select vendors
  • Convene and lead external scientific advisory committees
  • Secure all required approvals (health data access, ethics committees, regulatory compliance)
  • Manage the administrative, contractual, and budgetary aspects of studies
  • Review and validate all deliverables (protocols, analysis plans, study reports, publications)

Value communication and internal expertise

  • Translate study results into actionable clinical and economic arguments
  • Drive scientific dissemination (congresses, publications)
  • Serve as the internal reference point on epidemiology, health economics, and health data matters
  • Build and maintain a network of research agencies, academics, and institutions

Value and access strategy

  • Define and own the value demonstration strategy for each product across the region
  • Build economic value propositions and value dossiers and ensure their local adaptation
  • Contribute to pricing strategy and preparation for CEPS negotiations (e.g., positive externalities, budget impact)
  • Coordinate and build the economic modelling and CEESP dossier (early scientific advice, modelling, CEESP submission, technical exchange, etc.)
  • Contribute the health-economic and RWE content of early access dossiers and submissions to the Transparency Committee, in coordination with the Market Access Director, with progressively increasing ownership of Benelux dossiers
  • Anticipate assessors' objections and build responses ahead of submission

French rare disease ecosystem

  • Build working relationships with rare disease networks, reference and competence centres, patient associations, and learned societies
  • Negotiate collaborations with existing registries and cohorts
  • Contribute to documenting the patient journey and disease burden

Function leadership and development

  • Own and arbitrate the region's HEOR and RWE budget
  • Structure the function (methods, quality standards, vendor panel, review processes)
  • Recruit and manage future team members
  • Represent the region to global HEOR and Market Access teams

The above list of tasks is not exhaustive.

Where You’ll Work

  • This is a France-based role
  • Travel within France, a priority country, is expected, as is travel to our international office in Zug, Switzerland, for team alignment and engagement.
  • Travel to other countries in the EU West region may also be required. Local team meetings and the designated office location in France are in the Paris area.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Senior Value Engineer is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

The Role:

You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

The work you’ll do:

Identify & Frame Value

  • Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers 
  • Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive

Realize Value

  • Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement
  • Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives
  • Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

  • Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing
  • Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion
  • Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

 

The qualifications you need:

Live for Customer Value: Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.

Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value

Project Management: Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.

Executive Stakeholder Management: Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.

Business Domain Expertise: Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)

Industry Expertise: Ideally expertise in Aviation/Logistics/Transportation and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities   

Degree: In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program

About you You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements—an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most: High agency You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers. Boldness in learning You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. Proficiency in either Go or Typescript as well as in either Python or R, and experience with backend systems, data tooling, and data science frameworks are helpful for this role. Interest in AI You are interested not just in using AI in your work, but building tools for customers to use AI in their own work. You lean on your user empathy when building: knowing that some of our customers use and love AI in data science and others don’t or are restricted from using it.
